profile_text.body:
Tencent is a technology company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Maling. Its website describes it as offering a broad range of products and services to both consumers and businesses, and states that the company leverages technology to promote environmental sustainability, address social concerns, and support corporate governance.

In AI, Tencent develops the Hunyuan foundation model, tracked here under the Chinese Foundation Models category and accessible at hunyuan.tencent.com. The held facts note that cross-border data review is advised for users of Hunyuan, reflecting the compliance considerations that can accompany Chinese AI products used internationally.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent facts are present in the current held data for Tencent.
